blocks.text: The recruitment coordinator workflow on Mac

Your Mac is the command center for your hiring pipeline. You likely have Slack, an ATS like Workable or JobAdder, and a calendar open at all times. The goal is to move information between these tools without losing track of candidates. Slack is often where the coordination happens, but it can become a source of distraction if not managed well.

Learning these shortcuts saves you seconds every time you switch tasks. Over a day, those seconds add up to hours. If you ever get stuck, you can ask Lazur to point out where a specific menu item is located.
How Lazur helps you in Slack

Lazur is a voice assistant that lives in your Mac notch. It sees your screen when you hold ⌥ + ⌘. You can ask it to explain how to mute a noisy channel or find where your notification settings are hidden. It does not perform the action for you, but it guides you through the process so you never waste time hunting for buttons.

The scheduling tax is the time spent on back and forth emails and messages. To reduce this, keep your Slack status updated. Use ⌘ + Shift + Y to set your status quickly. If you are focused on sourcing, set your status to 'Deep Work' so teammates know why you are not replying immediately.

items: Ignoring thread replies: Always reply in a thread to keep channels clean.
Over-notifying: Use @here or @channel sparingly to avoid alert fatigue.
Forgetting to clear cache: If Slack behaves poorly, use Help > Troubleshooting > Clear Cache and Restart.
Not using search modifiers: Use from:name or in:channel to find messages faster.

blocks.text: Threads are essential for recruitment coordination. When you discuss a candidate in a channel, always use a thread for the feedback. This keeps the main channel feed available for important announcements. If you are having trouble finding the threads view, ask Lazur to point it out on your screen.

Notification overload is a real problem. If you miss important messages, check your system settings. Go to System Settings > Notifications > Slack. Ensure banners are enabled. If you need a break, use the /dnd command in Slack to pause alerts for a set time.

faq.question: Can Lazur send Slack messages for me?
faq.answer: No. Lazur cannot click buttons or send messages directly. It can help you dictate text or explain how to perform actions.

faq.question: Does Lazur work on Windows?
faq.answer: No, Lazur is currently built for macOS only.

faq.question: How do I get Lazur to see my Slack screen?
faq.answer: Hold the ⌥ + ⌘ keys while looking at your Slack window. Lazur will analyze the screen and answer your questions out loud.

faq.question: Is Lazur safe to use with candidate data?
faq.answer: Yes. Lazur does not store your screen data, and content is never used to train AI models.
